# awscc_ec2_fca_policy_association (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::EC2::FcaPolicyAssociation



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `associated_at` (String) The timestamp when the association was created.
- `association_mode` (String) The mode of the association.
- `expected_effective_at` (String) The timestamp when the association is expected to take effect.
- `fca_policy_association_id` (String) The ID of the FCA policy association.
- `fca_policy_id` (String) The ID of the FCA policy to associate.
- `managed_by` (String) Who manages the association: the account that created it, or a declarative policy.
- `network_resource_id` (String) The ID of the network resource to associate the FCA policy with.
- `network_resource_scope_type` (String) Associate by scope instead of directly. When set, NetworkResourceId is the ID of the scope (an account ID, a VPC ID, or a subnet ID) and the association covers every eligible network resource in that scope; when omitted, NetworkResourceId is a direct network resource (for example a NAT gateway or instance) and must match the policy's NetworkResourceType.
- `owner_account` (String) The AWS account ID that owns the FCA policy association.
